isosurfaces.name: Isosurfaces: Implicit to Explicit
isosurfaces.truth: Define a field, extract a surface. The boundary between inside and outside becomes geometry.
isosurfaces.qfep_connection: Marching algorithms find the edge—the threshold between states. This IS the edge of chaos made geometric: where density crosses zero, form emerges.
isosurfaces.description: Algorithms that extract surfaces from scalar fields. Marching Cubes walks through voxels finding boundaries, Marching Squares does 2D contours. Metaballs merge implicit surfaces. The implicit becomes explicit.
learning_objectives: Implicit surfaces: functions that define inside/outside
Metaballs: smooth organic shapes from distance fields
Terrain, caves, sculptures from noise fields
